svg.title: A tiny language model typing a quote
svg.desc: Animation of a small GPT written from scratch typing a sentence one character at a time. Each frame shows the 30 characters it reads, its attention weights from the newest character back to earlier ones, and its five likeliest next characters. The sentence: A comet flying into the unknown: I burn up from my own speed. But if I didn't burn, what would be the point of flying at all?

g.text: arctica-lm // a tiny GPT, written from scratch
context: the last 30 characters the model sees
next character: the likeliest of 36 (it always takes the top one)
